entries.2265b6f9d3263c3a: The company operates a single segment consisting of the manufacture, sale, maintenance and repair of commercial kitchen equipment, and sales for the fiscal year ended September 2025 break down into equipment sales of ¥15,177 million and repair and equipment sales of ¥2,941 million. Its core customers are in school lunch services, and it has expanded into collective catering in hospitals, welfare facilities and businesses. The filing discloses that no customer accounts for 10% or more of sales to external customers.
entries.22934a08d6c2f534: Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥18,118 million, a decrease of 1.8% from the previous year. The breakdown was ¥15,177 million in equipment sales and ¥2,941 million in repair and supplies sales.
entries.2c942c2ba95fcc9c: This is a single reportable segment covering the manufacture and sale of commercial kitchen equipment, and its maintenance and repair. It develops, manufactures, sells and repairs kitchen equipment for mass catering facilities and other facilities, and revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥18,118 million. Production is carried out at two plants, the Tochigi Plant and the Oita Plant, and branches and sales offices are located nationwide for sales and after-sales service. In kitchen planning, through its consulting services, it proposes the introduction of the most suitable products from among its own products and those of other companies.
entries.2da0914f81119e8c: It can be read that it has a track record of more than 70 years since its founding of constructing kitchen equipment for mass catering at facilities throughout Japan, and that it has accumulated after-sales service information.

entries.a1b5fa2c36d796cf: It can be read that it has a track record of more than 70 years since its founding of constructing kitchen equipment for mass catering at facilities throughout Japan, and that it has accumulated after-sales service information. It has a consulting service that proposes the optimal kitchen for each customer, and provides services consistently from planning through construction to after-sales service, in a form that enables introduction of the most suitable products, including those of other companies as well as its own. Its core products, dishwashers and rotating kettles for the school market, are shown as having a domestic production unit share of about 20% in fiscal 2020.
entries.a8460de9eccbef9b: It states that it will treat the school meals field as its most important market and roll out a direct sales system closely tied to local governments and communities. It states that it will also build a wide-area sales system for meal facilities at medical and welfare institutions and workplace canteens, and will implement strengthened sales of bundled equipment, promotion of product replacement through centralized management of delivery records, and collection of sales information through repair and maintenance inspections. As basic policies, it also sets out strengthening product capability and sales capability.
